verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs show offboarding-related access checking: the FreeAgent integration lets Sprinto map users and check whether someone with access has left the organization. There are also pages for monitoring access checks and running access reviews, plus a JumpCloud identity integration, though these are titles only. Nothing in the pack describes HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklists or proof that each new hire completed training. Missing for 10: HR-synced onboarding/offboarding checklists, training-completion tracking for new hires, documented access-revocation evidence for leavers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
